context: Remove blanket serial mode from the responsive block so an early failure cannot suppress unrelated viewport coverage, keeping serial only where a test genuinely depends on a previous test's state.
description: e2e/responsive.spec.ts sets test.describe.configure serial mode on line 35, so the first failure aborts every remaining test in the block. On develop 3af42e29b the single stale-headline failure suppressed 23 downstream tests, and both CI and a local run reported that only as '1 failed ... 23 did not run'. Behind the mask sat two genuine desktop and wide above-the-fold regressions that nobody could see. Verified 2026-08-03: switching the block to parallel mode locally ran all 25 tests and surfaced both real failures, so serial mode is not required for these tests to pass.

preserves.behavior: Any test that genuinely depends on prior state keeps an explicit narrow serial scope
Every existing responsive assertion is retained, none deleted to make the block pass

verifications.description: Blanket serial mode is gone from the responsive block
verifications.expected: Exits 1 on the unfixed tree where whole-file serial mode is still set on line 35; exits 0 once the blanket abort is removed.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 e2e/responsive.spec.ts
verifications.description: Every responsive test executes and passes
verifications.expected: All responsive tests run with zero did-not-run entries

work_units.evidence: Audited responsive.spec.ts for shared state: no beforeAll, no beforeEach, no module-level mutable state. Every test takes its own page fixture and sets its own viewport, so no test depends on a previous test's state. Serial mode bought nothing and only propagated aborts.
work_units.summary: Identify which responsive tests genuinely need shared state

work_units.evidence: Switched the block from mode serial to mode parallel with a comment recording why, so an independent viewport failure can no longer suppress unrelated coverage. No narrow serial scope was needed because no test shares state.
work_units.summary: Remove blanket serial mode and scope it narrowly if still needed

work_units.evidence: Behavioural proof, not just a green run. Injected a deliberate failure into the first viewport test: the suite reported 4 failed and 21 PASSED with zero did-not-run entries, so an early failure no longer suppresses unrelated coverage. Under the previous serial mode the same injection would have aborted the block. Probe reverted; only the mode change and its comment remain.
work_units.summary: Confirm the full block executes with no suppressed tests
